profile.headline: Senior Marketing Technology Engineer | Lifecycle Platforms and Integrations
profile.summary:
I build the systems that turn customer data into relevant lifecycle messaging. My work spans marketing platform administration, campaign architecture, integrations, and audience activation.

I build and improve marketing platforms, data integrations, and AI tools that help teams turn customer data into reliable lifecycle campaigns.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical ownership of marketing platforms supporting Growth Marketing and Servicing.
- Integration architecture connecting customer data, messaging platforms, and shared application services.
- CDP pipeline development, data activation, performance optimization, and operational reliability.
- Custom software and reusable tooling for marketing and engineering workflows.
- AI tool development and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

positions.title: Senior Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
- Salesforce Marketing Cloud development and platform administration.
- Email codebase optimization and reusable dynamic-content template frameworks.
- Lifecycle campaign automation and customer journey development.
- Audience segmentation, personalization, and campaign data quality.

positions.title: Senior Experience Consultant
positions.description:
- Marketing platform migrations, configuration, and campaign automation.
- Email and landing page development, codebase optimization, and reusable frameworks.
- Technical discovery, solution design, documentation, and client training.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Skills: ExactTarget · Communication · Cross-team Collaboration · Back-End Web Development · Application Services

positions.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Senior Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for the setup and ongoing performance of lifecycle marketing campaigns sent through the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform.

Specializing in:
Email Studio
Content Builder
Cloud Pages
Automation Studio
Journey Builder
Mobile Studio
MobileConnect
positions.insights: Skills: ExactTarget · Communication · Cross-team Collaboration · Back-End Web Development · Application Services

positions.title: Technical Producer
positions.description:
Produced and optimized highly dynamic, scalable email templates and custom email/web marketing solutions for Enterprise-level clients, leveraging Salesforce Marketing Cloud's Email Studio and Cloud Pages. Created and managed data extensions, data relationships, and data imports. Developed production, coding, and design documentation, and trained internal and client teams on best practices and new coding techniques.

Specializing in:
- Salesforce Marketing Cloud
- HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SQL, Guide Template Language
- Scalable framework design
- Kinetic/interactive email content
- Mobile optimization for email and web
- Relational data extensions and data imports
- Trigger and journey email campaigns
- Documentation and training
- Coding and design best practices
positions.insights: Skills: ExactTarget · Communication · Cross-team Collaboration · Back-End Web Development · Application Services

positions.title: Email Campaign Manager
positions.description:
Lead technical resource for the development, mobile optimization and performance testing of all US and Canada LivingSocial email templates. Supported and trained LivingSocial international teams in EMEA and APAC on email systems, production techniques and best practices.

- Responsible for the development and mobile optimization of daily and promotional email templates across 6 countries.
- Worked with design teams in developing new template wireframes and content architecture.
- Developed the strategy and implemented new user/onboarding and ongoing customer lifecycle email campaigns.
- Developed template performance testing strategies, analytics reports and best practices guidelines.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for managing enterprise level cross department projects, including  email campaign development and implementation, brand development, information architecture, and  social analytics. 

- Manage the development and implementation of enterprise level email campaigns across two dozen countries and languages
- Planning and execution of projects on time and on budget
- Develop and manage cross-functional project plans and teams
- QA of highly dynamic and complex email campaigns
- Monitor and review campaign performance metrics to best ensure project satisfaction
- Serve as expert on all aspects of execution within StrongView technologies

positions.title: Email Implementation Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for the coding, implementation and campaign management of ad hoc and transactional emails for Castrol's "John Force Racing" sponsorship and "Castrol Crew" online racing community.  

- Coding all ad hoc, newsletter and transactional email templates
- Management and segmentation of customer databases and email recipient lists
- Created email campaign summary and performance analytic reports

positions.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
positions.description:
Developed content strategies for client social community profiles and managed online community customer relations.  Responsible for all email asset management, quality assurance and campaign performance analytics and listening reports.  

- Managing client social and community profiles
- Responsible for client monthly social listening reports
- Created online community and social profile analytics reports
- Developed social and community profile content strategies
